name: edulearn
description: EduLearn — kurslarga yozilish platformasi (Web texnologiyalar yakuniy loyihasi)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run db:setup
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c gray,magenta,cyan "npm run db:start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n db,app -c gray,magenta "npm run db:start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix backend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
